920.error_description: Tinting Table test failed: the starting position is NOT on the reference mark, or no circuit has been detected, or the number of detected circuits is > 16, or the position of at least one detected circuit in one direction differs from that in the opposite direction by a quantity in steps > than the set threshold, or the position of at least one detected circuit differs from that obtained in the Self-Learning by a quantity > than the set threshold, or the map of detected circuits differs from that configured by software
